changeSet.author: dts
changeSet.comment: Register the dbt mart database as a copilot-ai datasource for Agent schema lookup and preview routing.
changeSet.sql: WITH updated_source AS ( UPDATE copilot_ai.data_source SET db_type = 'postgres', jdbc_url = 'jdbc:postgresql://${DTS_DBT_DB_HOST:host.docker.internal}:${DTS_DBT_DB_PORT:5432}/${DTS_DBT_DB_NAME:biadmin}', username = '${DTS_DBT_DB_USER:biadmin}', password = '${DTS_DBT_DB_PASSWORD:}', status = 'ACTIVE', description = 'DTS dbt build output database for PRS Agent BI schema lookup.', updated_at = ${now} WHERE lower(name) = lower('DTS dbt模型库') RETURNING id ), inserted_source AS ( INSERT INTO copilot_ai.data_source ( name, db_type, jdbc_url, username, password, status, description, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT 'DTS dbt模型库', 'postgres', 'jdbc:postgresql://${DTS_DBT_DB_HOST:host.docker.internal}:${DTS_DBT_DB_PORT:5432}/${DTS_DBT_DB_NAME:biadmin}', '${DTS_DBT_DB_USER:biadmin}', '${DTS_DBT_DB_PASSWORD:}', 'ACTIVE', 'DTS dbt build output database for PRS Agent BI schema lookup.', ${now}, ${now} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_source) RETURNING id ), resolved_source AS ( SELECT id FROM updated_source UNION ALL SELECT id FROM inserted_source ) UPDATE copilot_analytics.analytics_database db SET details_json = ( COALESCE(NULLIF(db.details_json, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('copilotDataSourceId', (SELECT id FROM resolved_source LIMIT 1)) )::text, updated_at = ${now} WHERE lower(db.name) = lower('DTS dbt模型库');
